source: Kramer, Stephanie, Yunping Tong and Anne Fengyan Shi. 2024. "Religious Composition of the World's Migrants, 1990-2020." Pew Research Center.
method: Global total ('Global Total', level 3) rows for Direction=Incoming, Year=2020, from Pew's 'Incoming and Outgoing Migrant Counts' file - Pew's own estimate of the religious composition of the world's international migrant stock (people living outside their country of birth), built primarily from 270 censuses and surveys plus Pew's own indirect-estimation methodology for gaps (see the Peru case study in this dataset's data/ folder for a worked example of that imputation).
